title: Member Information System Card — Estate Retirement of Later Distribution-Margin Allocations (Capital Credits)
content:
# Estate Retirement of Later Distribution-Margin Allocations

*Member information system reference — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).*

## Rule

A distribution-margin allocation booked to a deceased member's capital account after the estate's retirement was approved is retired for the estate under the same approved request, up to the class's estate annual cap of gross estate retirement in the calendar year; each such row is booked as one special retirement entry with retirement type estate for its gross, together with one payable entry for its payable, and the gross is the allocated amount of that year less every general retirement already booked on it.

## What the booking does

A later distribution-margin allocation is one whose allocation entry on the deceased member's capital account is dated after the board approval date of the estate's retirement request. Booking one such row for the estate:

- records a special retirement entry of the estate type, source distribution margin, for the gross allocated amount retired;
- records the matching payable entry for the amount owed to the estate net of the present-value discount;
- lowers the account's unretired credits by the gross and raises its retired credits owed by the payable.

The estate's claimant can then see the amount owed to the estate. One booking covers one later allocation year, under the estate's existing approved request.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `book_estate_later_allocation_bc10e318`, an agent-side tool. It is unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called by the agent with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `capital_account_id` | reference number of the deceased member's capital credit account, from the capital credit account lookup | identifier |
| `capital_request_id` | reference number of the estate's board-approved estate retirement request, from the capital credit request lookup | identifier |
| `allocation_year` | the patronage year of the later allocation, as on the allocation entry | four digits, YYYY |
| `gross_retired_amount` | the allocated amount being retired for the estate | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payable_amount` | the amount owed to the estate for that row net of the discount | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

The source is always recorded as `distribution_margin`; it is not a parameter.

### Return

A successful call returns `status` "booked", `retirement_entry_id`, `payable_entry_id`, `allocation_year` (YYYY), `allocation_source` (always `distribution_margin`), `gross_retired_amount`, `discount_amount` and `payable_amount` (USD, 2 decimals), and the account's new `unretired_balance` and `payable_balance` (USD, 2 decimals). The booking succeeded when the status is booked.

### Contract illustration (hypothetical values)

Gross 500.00 and payable 380.00 on an account owing 120.00 return a discount of 120.00, unretired credits lowered by 500.00 and a new amount owed of 500.00.
